# Studio verification testdata

Minimal fixtures for R4/R5 under `external_test/curbpack-studio/states/`.
Those scripts read `$CURBPACK_ROOT/testdata/...` where `CURBPACK_ROOT` is the
Studio repository root during verification.

- `demo-app/` — thin house-policy tree
- `honesty-eval/` — token-only and thin-real `SECURITY.md` overlays
